excerpt.zh:
[Root.GetName]的船员在[From.GetName]上有重大发现。该行星上的沙丘隐藏着一些废墟，是属于一个星际种群的。这类殖民地大都敌不过时间的洗礼。

科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]很快发现了一个藏有珍贵物品和文件的储物箱。既然这些文件是跟珍贵物品保存在一起，那一定相当重要。
excerpt.en:
On [From.GetName] the crew of the [Root.GetName] have found something extraordinary. The planet's dunes have hid several ruins, belonging to an interstellar civilization of settlers. The settlements have long been destroyed by the ravages of time.

texts.zh:
[Root.GetName]的船员在[From.GetName]上有重大发现。该行星上的沙丘隐藏着一些废墟，是属于一个星际种群的。这类殖民地大都敌不过时间的洗礼。

科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]很快发现了一个藏有珍贵物品和文件的储物箱。既然这些文件是跟珍贵物品保存在一起，那一定相当重要。
texts.en:
On [From.GetName] the crew of the [Root.GetName] have found something extraordinary. The planet's dunes have hid several ruins, belonging to an interstellar civilization of settlers. The settlements have long been destroyed by the ravages of time.

Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] is quick to discover a stored cache of valuables and documents. The collection of texts must have been most revered by the settlers, as they were stored amongst other valuables.

label.en: Send it to our homeworld for research.
Sell it to a private collector.

texts.zh: [From.From.From.GetName]上发现的文件似乎也是说书人特丽莎的著作。这些文件详细地解释如何重整基础设施和塑造社会。她的意思是所有人都牺牲自己的一部分幸福，为帝国共创美好的未来。
texts.en: It seems that the text we found on [From.From.From.GetName] is another piece created by "Telisa the Teller of Tales."The documents explicitly details how you can refocus infrastructure and shape society. She meant that by having everyone sacrifice some of their comfort for the greater good the nation will flourish.

texts.zh:
我们的语言专家废寝忘食数个月，终于成功翻译了[From.From.From.GetName]上找到的文献。这些文件是一位被称为说书人特丽莎的著作。她似乎是位非常有名的哲学家、社会学家、关系学家。

这些文件详细地解释如何重整基础设施和塑造社会。她的意思是所有人都牺牲自己的一部分幸福，为帝国共创美好的未来。
texts.en:
Having had our linguistics experts hard at work for months, we've finally succeeded in translating the works found on [From.From.From.GetName].The papers are the teachings of an alien scholar only referred to as "Telisa the Teller of Tales." All mentions of her points to her being a famous philosopher and overall expert on society and relations.

The documents explicitly details how you can refocus infrastructure and shape society. She meant that by having everyone sacrifice some of their comfort for the greater good the nation will flourish.

label.en: Splendid!
Reading 1
Reading 2

texts.zh:
[Root.GetName]的船员发来报告称，他们在[From.GetName]上找到了惊人的发现。其他文明的探索队在其表面留下了痕迹，并遗留了一些保存完好的档案及文物。

首席科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]提议将文献送回母星破译。但也可以将其卖给私人投资者。
texts.en:
The [Root.GetName]'s crew is reporting that they've found something spectacular on [From.GetName]. On the surface lies traces of an explorative expedition of another civilization. Left behind are some well-preserved documents and artifacts.

The proposed action by chief Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] is to send the text findings to our homeworld for translation. There is also the possibility to sell them off to a private investor.

label.en: Send it to our homeworld for research.
Sell it to a private collector.

texts.zh:
谁能想到呢？我们发现的文献记录了更多“说书人特丽莎”的教诲。这次，是一些对更宏观问题的哲思与分析。

她的教诲让我们对治理帝国有了更加深刻的理解，通过应用不同的看法，并在革命时关注宏观问题，可以获得更好的治理成果。
texts.en:
Who would've thought? The texts we found were more teachings from "Telisa the Teller of Tales." This time it's a collection of philosophical ponderings and analysis on larger questions.

Her teachings have provided us with much insight into how to better gain political results via applying different states of mind and use larger scale questions as a focus for reform.

texts.zh:
通过数周的研究，我们的语言学专家破解了[From.From.From.GetName]的文档中包含的内容。该文档记录了一位知名学者的哲学思辨，她被称为“说书人特丽莎”。

她的教诲让我们对治理帝国有了更加深刻的理解，通过应用不同的看法，并在革命时关注宏观问题，可以获得更好的治理成果。
texts.en:
After many weeks of study, our expert linguists have unearthed the meaning behind the documents found on [From.From.From.GetName]. The documents were philosophical ponderings by a famous scholar, only referred to as "Telisa the Teller of Tales."

Her teachings have provided us with much insight into how to better gain political results via applying different states of mind and use larger scale questions as a focus for reform.

label.en: Splendid!
Reading 1
Reading 2

texts.zh:
[From.GetName]的表面屹立着值得注意的建筑群。这些遗迹拥有不同的建筑风格，但都建于同一时代。[From.GetPlanetMoon]曾经可能是一个交易中心。

某些遗迹中存有文档和财物。我们可以通过研究文本来尝试翻译，以便了解曾定居在这里的生物。我们也可以将其卖给古董收藏家。
texts.en:
The surface of [From.GetName] holds something remarkable. Multiple ruins can be found, built using different architectures, yet from the same point in history. The [From.GetPlanetMoon] might have been a trading hub!

Some ruins held stored documents and valuables. If we studied the texts we might be able to translate them and learn more about the people who settled here. Or we could sell them to someone who values old heirlooms.

label.en: Send it to our homeworld for research.
Sell it to a private collector.

texts.zh:
谁能想到呢？我们发现的文献记录了更多“说书人特丽莎”的教诲。

这份文档记录了一些奇闻趣事、如何从星际外交中获取最大利益的建议和技巧。她相信，公平贸易和互相尊重的沟通可以为各界带来巨大的社会进步。
texts.en:
Who would've thought? The texts we found were more teachings from "Telisa the Teller of Tales."

The documents we found were a collection of anecdotes, suggestions and techniques for how to optimally partake in interstellar diplomacy. She seemed to have believed that good trade and respectful communication would achieve great social advancements for all parties.

texts.zh:
我们天才的语言学专家正在努力翻译[From.From.From.GetName]上发现的文献。文献的作者被称作“说书人特丽莎”，似乎是当时的德高望重之人。

这份文档记录了一些奇闻趣事、如何从星际外交中获取最大利益的建议和技巧。她相信，公平贸易和互相尊重的沟通可以为各界带来巨大的社会进步。
texts.en:
Our most talented linguists have been hard at work in translating the documents we found on [From.From.From.GetName]. The scribe behind these works is referred to as "Telisa the Teller of Tales," and it seems she was highly revered during her time.

The documents we found were a collection of anecdotes, suggestions and techniques for how to optimally partake in interstellar diplomacy. She seemed to have believed that good trade and respectful communication would achieve great social advancements for all parties.

label.en: Splendid!
Reading 1
Reading 2

texts.zh:
在[From.GetName]的荒野上，发现了战斗过的痕迹。在毫无生机的地表下，[Root.GetName]的研究员发现了骸骨和金属碎片，最令人吃惊的是一个装着文档的容器。

如果我们将文档送回母星破译，我们有机会了解这场战争和参与战争的种群。但也可以直接将其卖给古董商。
texts.en:
Across the barren fields of [From.GetName] there are indications of old battles being fought. Beneath the lifeless ground our researchers on the [Root.GetName] have found bones, metallic shards and, most surprisingly, a container filled with documents.

If we send the documents to our homeworld for translation we could potentially learn more about this war and who fought in it. It would also be possible to simply sell them off as antiques.

label.en: Send it to our homeworld for research.
Sell it to a private collector.

texts.zh:
我们从战场上挖掘到的文献上记录了更多“说书人特丽莎”的教诲。

这个文档对各种战术、战略进行了解析，最关键的是，其中包含星际战争的后勤学。特丽莎本人强烈反对战争，但她认为这种知识在未来时代仍然十分重要。“为了创建更美好的世界，即便是最和平的种群，也会有被逼迫到死角的时候。”
texts.en:
It appears that the texts we found buried in the battlefield were more teachings written by "Telisa the Teller of Tales."

The documents are breakdowns of tactics, strategy and, most importantly, logistics in interstellar warfare. Being a strong spokesperson against war, Telisa still found this to be essential knowledge for steering into the future. "Even the most peaceful of people might be forced into a corner in their work for a better world."

texts.zh:
几周来，我们的语言学专家一直在破译远古战场留下的文档。今天研究有了一些进展。我们得知，倒下的勇士遵循的教义来自于一个叫“说书人特丽莎”的哲学家。

这个文档对各种战术、战略进行了解析，最关键的是，其中包含星际战争的后勤学。特丽莎本人强烈反对战争，但她认为这种知识在未来时代仍然十分重要。“为了创建更美好的世界，即便是最和平的种群，也会有被逼迫到死角的时候。”
texts.en:
Our language experts have been at it for weeks to try and translate the documents we found in the old battlefield. Today we finally have some results. We now know that the fallen warriors all followed the teachings of a philosopher called "Telisa the Teller of Tales."

The documents are breakdowns of tactics, strategy and, most importantly, logistics in interstellar warfare. Being a strong spokesperson against war, Telisa still found this to be essential knowledge for steering into the future. "Even the most peaceful of people might be forced into a corner in their work for a better world."

label.en: Splendid!

label.zh: 看来智者也会选择战争。

texts.zh: 十分可惜，我们的语言学家未能完全理解[From.From.From.GetName]上古老文献的外星语言。不过，他们翻译了一些核心内容，让我们得以窥探那个文明的文化。
texts.en: Sadly our linguists have been unable to understand the entirety of the alien language used in the old documents found on [From.From.From.GetName]. However, they managed to translate the essentials, which has given us a glimpse into the culture they originated from.

label.en: Unfortunate.

texts.zh: 我们发现了一摞文件，这似乎对一个已经消亡的社群很重要。翻译它们定能为我们提供更深入了解其历史与文化的机会。
texts.en: We have uncovered a stash of documents that seem to have been important to the now dead society. Translating them will surely provide us with a more in-depth look into its history and culture.

texts.zh: 我们发现了一个外星人探险家携带的一些文本。如果我们能够翻译它们，我们也许能了解更多有关它曾经主人的信息。
texts.en: We've found some texts that were carried by an alien expedition. If we translate them we might uncover more information and learn about the previous owners.

texts.zh: 我们在一个貌似星际贸易站的废墟中发现了一些文本。如果我们能够翻译这些文件，我们可以更多地了解那些建立它的人。
texts.en: We've found some texts among the ruins of a possible interstellar trading hub. If we translate these documents we could learn more about the ones who founded it.

texts.zh: 我们在一个废弃已久的战场遗迹上发现了一群战士的遗骸，以及他们所携带的必定对他们很重要的文件。如果我们翻译这些文件，我们可以了解的更多关于这个种族以及他们所进行的战争。
texts.en: We found remains of a warrior people on a long abandoned battlefield, and they were carrying texts that must have been important to them. If we translate these documents we could learn more about this people and the wars they fought.
